 Thu, 19 Nov, 2026 - 17:00 Mother Jones festival announces dates for 16th annual event in Shandon 
 James Nolan, spokesperson for the festival, said: “We are happy to confirm that our 16th Annual Spirit of Mother Jones Festival will once again take place in the Shandon Historic Quarter in 2027." The late Joan Goggin from Togher, who for many years played the role of Mother Jones at the festival. Picture: Noel Sweeney
       Amy Campbell The Cork Mother Jones Committee has announced the dates for the 2027 Spirit of Mother Jones Festival in Shandon.
 The 16th Annual festival will take place from Thursday 22 to Saturday 24 July.
 James Nolan, spokesperson for the festival, said: “We are happy to confirm that our 16th Annual Spirit of Mother Jones Festival will once again take place in the Shandon Historic Quarter in 2027.
 “This festival and summer school is dedicated to the inspiring trade union leader and social justice advocate Mother Jones, who was born Mary Harris in Shandon in 1837.
 “Today Mary has become an international symbol for labour human rights across the world. This festival celebrates her life and achievements and supports the causes she fought for as the 100th Anniversary of her death in 1930 approaches.” 
 Mr Nolan added: “Recently we have witnessed the ground breaking ceremony for the erection of a wonderful statue to the Cork woman in Chicago which was performed by the Mayor of Chicago, Brandon Johnson and attended by a very large crowd.
 “We are hoping that Cork people will support our efforts to erect a statue to her here in Cork in time for the one hundred anniversary and we will ask the Cork City Heritage section for support in this endeavour.” 
 Mr Nolan acknowledged the practical support and encouragement of the Irish trade union movement and the assistance of the Cork City Council towards the festival each year.
 The Cork Mother Jones committee invites ideas for topics at next year’s festival, related to labour and trade union matters, heritage and history, social justice and human rights issues - email motherjonescork@gmail.com by 28 February 2027.
